modules._comment: loaders: the calls that load a module file. dynamic_dirs: directories loaded wholesale by a prefix plus a variable (lib/api.js reads lib/routes/ with readdirSync); a prefix load into any other directory is reported as unresolved.

domains._comment: The business domain catalogue: which domain owns which files. Used only to show traceability per domain.

kernel._comment: LXM-REQ-000232: entity types are stored through the kernel (its k_ tables: nodes, kinds, versions, hierarchies, events). A table outside it is a finding unless exempted here with a reason.

named_values._comment: LXM-REQ-000238: behaviour never branches on which environment it runs in; it reads a declared setting the environment sets. Matches a comparison of an environment-selector variable (any name ending in ENV, ENVIRONMENT or STAGE, e.g. NODE_ENV) with a literal, so no list of environment names is needed. Ordinary switches (a flag compared with "1") are settings, covered by the configuration adapter.
LXM-REQ-000238: no code names an environment. The names below are only what to look for; environments themselves are registered configuration, open-ended.
